title: Hinomori Shiho — Chatting With The Band〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(We start getting those tests back today, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I was able to prepare during our study sessions, so I don't think I did poorly on any of them...)

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, Shiho! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Saki...?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, Ichika and Honami are with you.
Did we agree to meet today? I forget.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, the three of us just happened to run into each other a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That alone came as a pretty big surprise.
Then you appeared, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe! Leo/need's all gathered up first thing in the morning! Now I've got a really good feeling about today♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? Just because we happened to run into each other?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, I can't help that I got the feeling!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hey, personal space...!
It's still way too early in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, we need to start heading over to our classrooms. Are you all free during lunch today?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I am.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I may have to attend a committee meeting.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's have lunch together if we all can.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which should I get...?
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, there you two are.
Buying from the school store today?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, Ichika, what happened to that committee meeting you mentioned?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: About that. I just sent a message, but I ended up finding you first.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, were you two about to eat? How do you feel about us having lunch together today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do it! We should since we can!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm glad you said that...!
I'll buy my food right away.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, let's see... Three yakisoba buns, please.
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Phew...
You seem really excited today for some reason, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I was just thinking the same thing!
It sounded like you were having a lot of fun just now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, you think so...?
Now that you mention it, maybe I have been able to focus more than usual.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is it because you did well on those tests?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not exactly...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I played this song a lot during the breaks I took from studying, so I know it all by heart.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Although, those breaks did sometimes end up lasting for an hour.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know what you mean.
Anyway, we need to get going in a bit, so why don't we call our next one our last?
A few hours later
Diner

rows.Speaker: Waitress
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience!
Here are your limited-time caramel pudding parfaits.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, this looks amazing!
Check out these cherries! They're huge!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, we know.
We all ordered the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we have our parfaits, we can finally start. Congratulations to all of us for getting through those tests! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Shiho, Honami & Saki
rows.Line:
Cheers.
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe!
We've gotten to spend so much time together today♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it all started with us running into each other out by the school gate. We even had lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, considering how we spend our weekends together practicing, I'm amazed that we haven't gotten sick of each other...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Why would we?!
We're the Bestest Childhood Friends Forever!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: B-Bestest Childhood Friends Forever?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You keep coming up with these weird group names for us...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's cute, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But... I want us to spend even more time together! Twenty-four hours a day, 365 days a year!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A whole year might be difficult...
But we could try having another sleepover. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I'd love to do that again. Especially since the last one we had was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's do it!
You're up for another sleepover, right, Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, but we see each other basically every day. I don't think we have to spend even more time together than we already do...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Grr...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, Hona...
Shiho says she doesn't want to have another sleepover with us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... Maybe she's against us having a regular sleepover. What if we turned it into a two-day trip to PXL?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that won't leave us much time to practice. What if we turned it into a training camp instead? Would that be enough to entice her...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can hear you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Alright, I can tolerate a training camp.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But I have to think about it first.
I mean, we're all really busy, so we don't exactly have time for extended travel.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Let us know when you think we can go, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. It's pretty easy to get you to change your mind when we really try.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Quit saying stuff like that.
Anyway, we gotta eat our parfaits before they melt.
